en: A black‑and‑white postcard showing a large historical pageant or tournament held in a city square. In the foreground, mounted riders in medieval-style costumes circle a central pole with long ribbons, while crowds fill grandstands and line the streets on both sides. A temporary castle-like gate stands at the back of the arena, and multi‑story European townhouses with shops (one sign reads "AU BON MARCHE") form the backdrop. Printed caption text appears at the bottom in French, identifying the scene as an event in Bruges.
